2610.08183.title: Compact Robot Policies Need Fine-Grained Visual Representations
2610.08183.paper_summary: Multi-task manipulation policies differ in architecture, scale, and pretrained priors all at once, so published comparisons cannot attribute performance to any single component. We argue that most of it comes from the visual representation, and that parameter scale and generative priors are largely incidental. To test this, we build CoRP (Compressed Representation Policy), a deliberately compact policy (48.9M parameters, no vision-language model and no video-generative prior) that factorizes into a representation extractor and a flow-matching action generator. It reaches 97.0% on LIBERO and 75.78%/73.36% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized, matching systems 40.9-163.6x larger. Holding the action generator fixed, we then vary one extractor property at a time. Pretrained initialization is decisive: a random ViT-S/14 drops to 78.1% and an ImageNet ResNet-34 to 74.5% on LIBERO. Pretraining alone is not enough, as freezing the encoder costs 19.8 points. Compression matters as much: resampling each view to 48 tokens beats passing all patch tokens (97.0% vs 83.2%), and a variational information bottleneck over those tokens is worse than a hard token budget, cutting LIBERO-Goal from 95.8% to 33.0% by suppressing the instruction-dependent token selection the policy relies on. Language conditioning contributes only where the observation leaves the goal ambiguous (LIBERO-Goal: 9.2% to 95.8%), while on RoboTwin 2.0, where observations are unambiguous, removing it slightly improves success. Therefore, we argue that a compact policy works when its representation is pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed. Project page: https://corp-policy.github.io/
2610.08183.paper_summary_zh: 多任務操作政策在架構、規模和預訓練先驗上同時存在差異，因此已發表的比較無法將性能歸因於任何單一組件。我們認為大部分性能來自於視覺表示，而參數規模和生成先驗在很大程度上是附帶的。為了測試這一點，我們構建了 CoRP（壓縮表示政策），這是一個故意緊湊的政策（48.9M 參數，沒有視覺-語言模型和沒有視頻生成先驗），它分解為一個表示提取器和一個流匹配動作生成器。它在 LIBERO 上達到 97.0%，在 RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized 上達到 75.78%/73.36%，匹配的系統大約是其 40.9-163.6 倍。固定動作生成器後，我們逐一變化一個提取器屬性。預訓練初始化是決定性的：隨機的 ViT-S/14 在 LIBERO 上降至 78.1%，而 ImageNet ResNet-34 降至 74.5%。僅僅進行預訓練是不夠的，因為凍結編碼器會損失 19.8 分。壓縮同樣重要：將每個視圖重新取樣為 48 個標記的效果優於傳遞所有補丁標記（97.0% 對 83.2%），而對這些標記進行變分信息瓶頸的效果不如硬標記預算，通過抑制政策依賴的指令依賴標記選擇，將 LIBERO-Goal 從 95.8% 降至 33.0%。語言條件僅在觀察使目標模糊的情況下有所貢獻（LIBERO-Goal: 9.2% 到 95.8%），而在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，當觀察是明確的時，去除它會稍微提高成功率。因此，我們認為一個緊湊的政策在其表示經過預訓練、適應任務和壓縮時有效。項目頁面：https://corp-policy.github.io/
